  gs.script_content,
  cs.creator_id,
  cs.niche,
  cs.selected_video_id,

SELECT
  COALESCE(ir.caption, tv.title) AS title,
  COALESCE(ir.author, tv.author) AS author,
  COALESCE(CAST(ir.views AS TEXT), tv.views) AS views,
  COALESCE(CAST(ir.likes AS TEXT), tv.likes) AS likes,
  COALESCE(ir.hashtags, tv.hashtags::text) AS hashtags,
  COALESCE(ir.niche, tv.category) AS category
FROM (SELECT '{{ $json.selected_video_id }}' AS vid) q
LEFT JOIN instagram_reels ir ON ir.reel_id = q.vid
LEFT JOIN trending_videos tv ON tv.video_id = q.vid
LIMIT 1;

parameters.text:
=You are a viral Instagram Reels scriptwriter and creative director.

A creator has selected this TRENDING POST as inspiration:
{{ $json.videoContext }}

Niche: **{{ $json.niche }}**
Style: {{ $json.style }}

{{ $json.userPrompt ? "Creator's specific angle: " + $json.userPrompt : '' }}

Your job: write an ORIGINAL 15-30 second Instagram Reel script that is INSPIRED by the above post. Borrow its energy, hook style, and what made it go viral. Make it fresh and engaging.

Provide your response as a JSON object with these fields:
- hook: A punchy opening line (2 seconds)
- middle: The main body of the script
- cta: A strong call-to-action
- visual_directions: Brief visual direction notes
- music_vibe: Suggested music mood
- hashtags: Array of 5-8 relevant hashtags (include #)
- full_script: The complete spoken script

Output ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no explanation.

## Instagram Workflow (Pexels Cheat Code)

Three sub-flows:
1. **Scrape** (instagram-scrape) — Apify
2. **Generate** (instagram-start) — Gemini script → Pexels video + Django TTS/mix
   ⚠️ fal.ai node kept but SKIPPED (disabled)
3. **Approve & Publish** (instagram-video-approve) — Instagram Graph API

Chain: Save Script → Prepare Video Prompt → Extract Keywords → Pexels Search → Django Mix → Extract Video URL

Pexels API Key: configured in Search Pexels node
IG Business Account ID: 17841480637267691
Gemini credential: z3ZN07pI6NnC0s81
